purpose: W-SPREAD-CELL1 Line 2 (registration section 'Which close the look uses'): explicit GET /markets requests of up to 100 tickers, the first market ticker (sorted) of each of the 1041 events. Only the time fields close_time, expected_expiration_time and occurrence_datetime are used; no price and no result is read.
heldout: none (time fields only; used by the SPREADCELL1 scorer as Line 2, read once with it)
notes: 11 requests, one page each (limit 100 matches the 100 tickers). Fields the reader keeps: ticker, event_ticker, close_time, expected_expiration_time, occurrence_datetime. Whether /markets accepts 100 comma separated values in 'tickers' was not verified; a short answer leaves those events without a Line 2 time (reported as missing). Source list (frozen, on the refine-live branch): kalshi-scalper/refine_tools/SPREAD_CELL1_EVENTS.json.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
